name: Auriferous-Voe

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by petrified remnants of a former biosphere and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the derelict space station in orbit left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
